content:
The main event Amazon Black Friday sale is flying, and, much like some of you, we didn’t quite finish up our shopping during yesterday’s wild sale. For Black Friday edition of In My cart we are sharing with everyone the deals we are about to or have already checked out with today. From Amazon’s new Echo Time and Aulumu’s G05 Pro to a brick built Statue of Liberty and the LEGO Icons Project Hail Mary set, we are also scoping out Anker’s foldable 3-in-1 charger, this faux fur throw blanket, the wild deal on AirPods Pro 3 at $100 off, the all-time low on Apple Watch Series 12, and the Apple Gift Card promotion with a FREE $15 Amazon credit attached. Check it all out below.

Karthik

My Black Friday cart today is mostly about smaller upgrades that I’ve been meaning to pick up, and there’s no better time to grab them for less. Amazon’s new Echo Time is particularly tempting as a replacement for my aging Echo Dot, while the GameSir X5 Lite Xbox 25th Anniversary Edition looks like a fun addition to any mobile gaming setup. UGREEN’s Nexode 240W USB-C cable with a built-in TFT display is another neat accessory I’ve had my eye on, and Black Friday seems like a good excuse to grab one for less. I’m also considering Anker’s 100W Universal Travel Charger to keep my devices charged without juggling multiple adapters on my upcoming trips.

  • Anker Nano 100W Universal Travel Charger $60 (Reg. $80)
  • UGREEN Nexode 240W USB-C to USB-C Cable with TFT Smart Display $16 (Reg. $23)
  • Amazon’s all-new Echo Time $100 (Reg. $200)
  • GameSir X5 Lite Xbox 25th Anniversary Edition $36 (Reg. $45)

Simon

If there’s a recurring theme among the items in my cart this Black Friday, it’s that I tend to gravitate toward gear that simplifies things a bit. Aqara’s U400 smart lock would allow me to walk up to my front door without even having to lift my wrist, while Tapo’s Matter in-wall outlets could help eliminate some of the bulky smart plugs throughout my home. As for gear I could take on the go, I’m a big fan of what Baseus has done with its palm-sized travel adapter and integrated 70W retractable USB-C cable. Aulumu’s G05 Pro also caught my eye, as I really dig the idea of having an entire miniature toolkit tucked away inside a MagSafe kickstand.

  • Aulumu G05 Pro MagSafe Multi-Tool: $29 (Reg. $36)
  • Aqara UWB Smart Lock U400: $200 (Reg. $270)
  • Tapo Matter In-Wall Outlet: $18 (Reg. $26)
  • Baseus 6-in-1 70W Retractable USB-C Travel Adapter: $36 (Reg. $50)

Rein

Well, if I didn’t already have a bunch in my cart for Black Friday, I certainly do now, as I just can’t pass up the opportunity to upgrade my home and hobbies while so many things are at their best prices of the year. For one, I’m upgrading to the Philips Sonicare 5950 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush that steps up the game from my more standard electric model, not to mention grabbing the Dyson V9 Motorbar Cordless Vacuum to replace my previous legacy model from the brand. After grabbing the new Govee Floor Lamp 3 with Matter for my living room, I decided I also want to grab the equally new Lantern Floor Lamp counterpart to bring more ambiance to my bedroom. I’ve also added a few more notable LEGO deals, too, some of which are retired and harder to find sets, like the Architecture Statue of Liberty. You’ll find everything else going straight into my cart below:

  • Philips Sonicare 5950 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush: $60 (Reg. $110)
  • LEGO Icons Transformers Bumblebee: $63 (Reg. $90)
  • LEGO Icons Project Hail Mary: $70 (Reg. $100)
  • LEGO Architecture Statue of Liberty: $84 (Reg. $120)
  • LEGO Mario Kart – Mario & Standard Kart: $136 (Reg. $170)
  • Govee Lantern Floor Lamp: $100 (Reg. $130)
  • Ninja Artisan Pizza Oven: $200 (Reg. $300)
  • Dyson V9 Motorbar Cordless Vacuum: $270 (Reg. $600)
  • Nebula P1i Portable Projector with Flippable Speaker: $279 (Reg. $399)

Jenna

My Black Friday cart is full of those brand-name goodies that make everyday life feel easier and more luxurious. I highly recommend these gifts for the women in your life or anyone who wants to add a bit of a spa-like experience to their everyday routine. You can’t beat UGG for coziness, and Maison Louis Marie perfumes and candles smell like nothing else: unique, rich, and classy. If you’re buying PJs, go for modal for its cooling feel and softness. For something really special, gift her the Oura Ring, the sleekest health and fitness tracker out there.

  • UGG Adalee Throw Blanket for Sofa, Faux Fur Blanket, 50″ x 70″, Seal Grey $72 (Reg. $100)
  • UGG Women’s Elea Slip-on minimalist Slippers $80 (Reg. $130)
  • Maison Louis Marie No.04 Bois de Balincourt Soy Wax Candle, 8.5 oz $32 (Orig. $40)
  • Victoria’s Secret Women’s Modal Pajama Set, Short Sleeve Button Down Shirt & Shorts $52 (Reg. $70)
  • Our Place Always Pan 2.0, 10.5″ Ceramic Nonstick Pan, 2.6 Qt $80 (Reg. $135)
  • Oura Ring 5 Smart Ring – Fitness & Sleep Tracker $300 (Reg. $400)

Michael

My Black Friday cart is a mix of practical upgrades and a couple of picks just for fun. Anker’s foldable 3-in-1 charger will make travel easier: I can charge my iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods without packing a separate charger and cable for each. Amazon’s Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro can record 4K video around the clock, making it a great way to keep an eye on my home. The Moccamaster is the best coffee maker I’ve ever owned, so I’m getting one for my mom for Christmas. It brews a pot quickly and piping hot, and I love its simple, analog design. Finally, Star Wars Galactic Racer is at its Black Friday low, and the LEGO Icons Project Hail Mary set is on sale too. Amaze! Amaze! Amaze!

  • Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger $95 (Reg. $150)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $150 (Reg. $250)
  • Technivorm Moccamaster 10-Cup Coffee Maker $248 (Reg. $370)
  • Star Wars Galactic Racer $30 (Reg. 60)
  • LEGO Icons Project Hail Mary $70 (Reg. $100)

Chance

There are some wild Apple deals out there right now for Black Friday, and one standout for me is the Apple Watch Series 12. I think it’s a great update over the Series 11, and it’s especially compelling starting at $299 (Reg. $399). I know at least one person in my life will be unwrapping one this holiday season. Additionally, I’m planning to upgrade my lawn watering game next spring, so I’ve got my eye on the Eve Aqua Smart Water Controller at $50 off to bring home HomeKit fun to that.

  • Apple Watch Series 12 from $299 (Reg. $399)
  • Eve Aqua Smart Water Controller $100 (Reg. $150)
  • Apple Studio Display $1,399 (Reg. $1,599)
  • Aqara UWB Smart Lock U400 $200 (Reg. $270)
  • Aqara W200 with Adaptive Temperature $119 (Reg. $159)

Justin

I did most of my Black Friday shopping yesterday, but I didn’t pull the trigger on the AirPods Pro 3 deal at $100 off yet, so you can guarantee those are in the ol’ cart and now the wife wants another AirTag 2 (at the $18 all-time low I can handle that). I;m also going to grabbing a couple %0 Apple gift cards for some close colleagues while I can weasel $15 in FREE Amazon credit out of it with the Black Friday promotion, and my mom said she wants this faux fur throw blanket for the living room – currently down at $30.50 shipped for Prime members.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $149 (Reg. $249)
